panels.description: One line per asset. CRAH-01 and ROOM-01 are degrees C. UPS-01 is percent.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "facility")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "facility_asset" and r._field == "reading")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: r.asset_id}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)

panels.title: Reading

panels.description: RUNNING until a scripted fault latches. CRAH-01 faults at about 3 minutes. ROOM-01 faults at about 6 minutes. UPS-01 stays running. Each bar stops at the last sample, so a stopped demo does not keep its last color out to now.

targets.query:
import "experimental"
import "internal/debug"

data = from(bucket: "facility")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "facility_asset" and r._field == "reading")
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: if r.status == "FAULTED" then 1 else 0, _field: r.asset_id}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> aggregateWindow(every: v.windowPeriod, fn: last, createEmpty: false)
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({_time: r._time, _value: r._value, _field: r._field}))
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])

ends = data
  |> last()
  |> map(fn: (r) => ({
      _time: experimental.addDuration(d: 1s, to: r._time),
      _value: debug.null(type: "int"),
      _field: r._field,
    }))

union(tables: [data, ends])
  |> group(columns: ["_field"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

panels.title: Status
